thread:
Aisha (AE): Kicking off Monarch Mutual POC. They need enterprise SSO (Okta pref), SCIM provisioning with group->role mapping, strict BU isolation, EU data residency, and a written failover behaviour for auth if control-plane connectivity is lost. Also they asked for price diff Dedicated vs Private and any platform blockers (HSM, SIEM forwarding). @Liam @Rina
Oliver (Monarch IT): Quick constraints from our side: 1) SCIM cannot be internet-facing; must go through an internal proxy/connector. 2) Domain verification must be via email to admin@monarch.internal (no DNS TXT allowed). 3) Session logs must be retained for 24 months and exported to our Splunk instance. 4) SAML assertion lifetime max 8h.
Liam (Solutions Eng): We support Okta/OIDC and SAML (IdP/SP). Email-based domain verification is supported for accounts with private deployments; for Hosted API we require DNS TXT. SCIM bridge (connector) can run in their network and forward over TLS to our control plane. Example SCIM PUT user create payload: ```PUT /scim/v2/Users Content-Type: application/json { "userName":"j.smith@monarch.com", "name": {"givenName":"John","familyName":"Smith"}, "emails": [{"value":"j.smith@monarch.com","primary":true}], "groups": ["Claims","Underwriting"] }```
Rina (Security): Compliance notes: EU data residency is available on Private (VPC) and on-prem. We can ship logs to their Splunk via syslog or S3 export; retention 24 months is fine but may require extended log retention add-on. HSM support for key wraps is GA in Private cloud VPC deployments; on-prem HSM supported with extra integration effort. We don't store plaintext credentials; we store auth events.
Marco (Sales Eng): Pricing overview: Dedicated = reserved capacity + shared control plane (lower platform fee). Private (VPC) = higher platform fee + infra; on-prem has licensing + install support charge. I'll put together numbers based on Monarch's expected qps. Lead times: Dedicated ~2-3 weeks, Private VPC ~4-8 weeks, on-prem depends on their ops.
Oliver (Monarch IT): Also need confirmation that BU admins can only manage users in their BU. We have nested groups and need role scoping.
Liam (Solutions Eng): RBAC: we support attribute-based role mapping via SAML/SCIM attributes. We can scope admin roles to groups and tenant IDs. For nested groups we can map group path -> role. Sample mapping rule: if group startsWith "bu-" then assign role "BU_ADMIN" scoped to tenant_id claim.
Rina (Security): Failover behaviour (summary): 1) SCIM-connector buffers operations locally and retries with exponential backoff. 2) Authentication continues using cached session tokens for up to 30 minutes after control-plane disconnect. 3) For Private/on-prem, local auth fallback (AD/LDAP) continues uninterrupted. I'll draft a short runbook.
